messages:
ash: Heads up — migration guide anchor broken after mkdocs 1.x -> 2.x upgrade. Link from migrations/2025.md#step-3 404s in the site.

maria: saw the linkcheck fail in CI earlier. Can you paste the failing URL or repro steps?

ash: repro locally with `mkdocs serve`. The heading is: "Step 3 — Configure the router" but the generated slug is different (there's an en-dash/soft-hyphen subtlety). The link we use is plain ASCII: `#step-3-configure-the-router` so it doesn't match.

ash: snippet: 
```markdown
### Step 3 — Configure the router
...content...
[Jump to step 3](./2025.md#step-3-configure-the-router)
```

docsite-bot: linkcheck: ERROR migrations/2025.md: anchor not found: #step-3-configure-the-router

liam: MkDocs slugifier will turn the en-dash into a different codepoint -> different slug. Two options: normalize the heading to use a plain hyphen, or add an explicit id to the header: `### Step 3 — Configure the router {#step-3-configure-the-router}`.

maria: explicit id is least invasive for the migration guide. I'll open a tiny PR (no copy edits).

ash: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 — added the explicit id and updated CHANGES.md to note the mkdocs upgrade caveat.

docsite-bot: CI linkcheck started for PR 4567.

docsite-bot: linkcheck: recheck passed ✅ (preview site).

deploy-bot: preview published for PR 4567 — https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/docs/migrations/2025.html#step-3-configure-the-router

ash: verified the anchor resolves now on preview. :thumbsup:

maria: will merge once we have one more approval.

liam: approved, tiny nit but not blocking.

maria: merged and backported to stable branch.

deploy-bot: prod docs deploy triggered and completed.

ash: thanks everyone — closing the thread.
